replay_method: Reconstruct the V2 family from the Huang graph definition and frozen seed, recompute root/descendant source classes and canonical singleton promotion, then re-audit all E2 C1-C9 application preconditions without using the primary result as an assumption.

source_graph: Underlying graph is exactly Huang G_{C7,I_k}; no edge is added by the source-state overlay.
Huang's P7-free construction theorem therefore applies directly.
seed_and_root_X0: S={h1_0,x2,h1_1,h1_6} with colors 2,1,3,4 is proper and connected.
No outside vertex is complete to S.
~x2 sees seed colors {1,3,4} and has unique color 2.
d2 sees seed colors {2,3,4} and has unique color 1.
No other root source singleton exists.
Promoting ~x2=2,d2=1 to X0 preserves properness and G-X0 connectedness.
B0_vacuity: Residual Y0 consists of stable C-type vertices anticomplete to S.
Every Y vertex with a residual-Y0 neighbor is U-type with source list {2,3,4}.
Hence there is no competing second Y 3-list class at the residual boundary and no B0 source-Z provenance obligation is required.
optional_force_closure: Forcing optional positive literal v_i to color 1 is palette-admissible and pairwise proper.
~v_i then has unique source color 2 and is deterministically promoted to X0.
Every C occurrence of v_i leaves Y0 and becomes dynamic Y with source list {2,3,4}.
No Z0 is produced and G-X0 remains connected.
The stored explicit four-coloring extends every subset F.
QALL_and_profiles: U remains complete to the live X/D side, keeping the dynamic core connected.
Every residual C singleton carrier attaches to its literal/D and adjacent U vertices.
For optional d_i, q_i=binom(k-1,2)+k^2+i is unique.
Unforced v_i gives signature (q_i,0); forced v_i gives (0,q_i).
Thus F is structurally recoverable from the reduced canonical profile and the family has exactly 2^k profiles.
four_color_activity: After root X0 propagation, d1 has exact list {1,2}.
An ordinary U vertex has exact list {3,4}.
Their union is [4], excluding C1 common-palette reduction.
Explicit permanent nonedge pairs witness colors 1,2,3,4 in authorized R2 queries.
compiled_C7: Every residual C singleton has base [4] and compiles to one [4]-selector on the same D_C neighborhood.
Every non-distinguished clause therefore retains an induced C7 in the compiled dynamic+selector graph.
dependency_support: The optional clause family contains every 3-subset, so the optional support primal graph is K_k.
Any nontrivial split of optional variables is crossed by a clause support.
The primal treewidth is k-1; no bounded singleton/pair/running-intersection variable interface exists as k grows.
